(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and
      (at start (raw ?i))
      (at start (grill_free))

    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))

    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (stackable bun_bot))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (stackable bun_bot)))
      (at end (stacked bun_bot))
    )
  )

  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and
      (at start (grilled chicken))
      (at start (stackable chicken))
      (at start (stacked bun_bot))
    )
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (stackable chicken)))
      (at end (stacked chicken))

  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    feast_plate patty20 salmon20 chicken20 tofu20 fish20 falafel20 potato20 onion20 yam20 turnip20 stock20 beans20 lettuce20 tomato20 cucumber20 carrot20 - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free1) (grill_free2) (grill_free3)
    (cutting_board_free1) (cutting_board_free2) (cutting_board_free3) (cutting_board_free4)

    (boiler_free1) (boiler_free2) (boiler_free3)
    (marinator_free1) (marinator_free2) (marinator_free3)
  )

    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free1)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (raw ?i))) (at start (not (grill_free1))) (at end (grilled ?i)) (at end (stackable ?i)) (at end (grill_free1))))
